title: Acts – Jude — The 12 Disciples, God's Holy People
Genesis 1–2 — God and Righteous People in Paradise
summary:
This is the top of the left side. Its match at the bottom right is Rev 20-22 — Paradise Restored.
Read them side by side before you go further.

title: Genesis 3–5 — Satan and Sin Enter
summary: Matches Rev 20 — Satan Cast Out. What enters here is removed there, by name.

title: Genesis 6–9 — The World Judged and Destroyed
summary: Matches Rev 06-19 — The World Judged. Same verdict, wider scope, final.

title: Genesis 10–11 — One World Government
summary:
Matches Rev 01-18 — Babylon. Babel is the seed; Babylon the Great is the full-grown tree.
Note that at Pentecost (Acts–Jude — The Church) the language curse is temporarily reversed.

title: Genesis 12 – Malachi — The 12 Tribes, God's Holy People
summary: Matches Acts–Jude — The Church. Twelve tribes, then twelve disciples. Same office, new covenant.

title: The Gospels — Jesus Christ (God)
summary:
Everything on the left side climbs toward Him and everything on the right side descends from Him.
He is not the middle of the story chronologically. He is the middle of it structurally.

title: Revelation 1–18 — One World Government
summary:
Matches Gen 10-11 — Babel. What God scattered at Babel gathers again here, and is destroyed
rather than merely dispersed.

title: Revelation 6–19 — The World Judged and Destroyed
Revelation 20 — Satan and Sin Exit
summary: Matches Gen 03-05 — Sin Enters. This is the single cleanest pair on the whole diagram.

title: Revelation 20–22 — God and Redeemed People in Paradise
summary:
Matches Gen 01-02 — Creation — but it ends in a city, not a garden. Something was gained,
not just recovered.
